description: Use this when the user asks about their profit, income and expenses, or profit and loss for this month, this quarter or given dates. Profit and loss for a period, the same figures as the Profit & loss page in Fatura Go, whose basis depends on the business (basis_kind). cash (accounting off): income (customer payments received in the period, excluding VAT, less credit-note refunds), expenses excluding VAT by category, and profit, per currency; supplier bills are not included and currencies are not added together. ledger (accounting on): revenue, cost of sales, gross profit, expenses and net profit from the books in AED, by report line. Say which basis it is when presenting it. period this_month (default), this_quarter, or custom with date_from and date_to. Needs access to expenses (or accounting once the books are on). Do not use it for per-unit profit on a product (calculate_profit) or for VAT (get_vat_summary).

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out when the connection shares exactly one business.

date_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD, document date on or after.

date_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, document date on or before.

period.description: Default this_month; custom needs date_from and date_to.

name: get_profit_and_loss
title: Profit and loss
